name: Duo two-factor authentication
summary: Verify your identity and manage your Duo authentication methods

details.title: Duo and Passport York
details.html: Duo is the second-factor authentication service used to protect Passport York and other York sign-ins. It is not Passport York itself and does not replace the Passport York username and password

details.title: Methods
details.html: Depending on eligibility and configuration, approved methods include Duo Mobile, hardware tokens, passcodes and phone-call verification. Follow the instructions for your method and contact IT if you can no longer access your enrolled device
